repeated_shape: STRAWBERRY mark residual increases in all 5.
MELON mark residual increases in all 5.
SHEEP mark residual increases in all 5.
COW mark residual decreases in all 5.
SHEEP mark residual increases in all 5.
COW mark residual increases in all 5.

STRAWBERRY and MELON contributions are smaller and not compositionally identical across all 5.

shared: Both pulses increase total committed-production residual in all 5 Battles.
SHEEP mark residual increases in all 5 Battles in both pulses.
Neither pulse adds an opponent-minus-self animal-count difference; animal mark changes occur without animal-count residual change.
different: Pulse A is crop-dominant; Pulse B is animal-dominant.
Pulse A is characterized by large STRAWBERRY + MELON residual growth; Pulse B is not.
COW residual moves in opposite directions: negative in Pulse A, positive in Pulse B.
The two pulses therefore do not share one specific crop/animal composition.

interpretation_boundary: The repeated temporal ordering is stronger than any single crop/animal explanation.
SHEEP is a repeated component but is not sufficient to identify a unique mechanism or policy target.
Different productive-State compositions can precede the same output/SELL/Cash response-shaped sequence.
No Action, causal mechanism, Representation, Evaluation, Direction, Candidate, or policy mutation is inferred.
